question: Can target-free predict-and-optimize inference turn continuous expected trajectory risk into an Energy-consistent probability measure while retaining an independently optimal Bayes top1 decision?

hypotheses.primary: A simplex optimizer driven only by C130 predicted ADE risk and candidate geometry reduces fold-0 Energy to within 1% of C127 B0 without changing C130 top1 decisions.
hypotheses.mechanism: For a finite trajectory measure, expected Energy equals predicted expected target distance minus one half of probability-weighted pairwise candidate distance; solving that objective is more faithful than converting risks to softmax logits.
hypotheses.rival: C130 risk estimates are too poorly calibrated for optimization, so target-free simplex decisions will not recover the label-only Energy feasibility seen in C131.
hypotheses.null: P0-A fails its Energy, replay, finiteness, simplex, or information-boundary gate.

dataset.name: trajair_111day_c12
dataset.access_policy: C134 may open only processed_data/train and frozen train-date folds. Development and consumed locked test are unavailable.

p0_a.name: target_free_fixed_geometry_probability_audit
p0_a.candidate_source: frozen C130 R1 checkpoint (C129 physical K=5 geometry)
p0_a.predicted_target_distance: C130 centered predicted normalized ADE multiplied by frozen ADE scale
p0_a.pairwise_distance: mean 3D Euclidean distance over all 24 future steps between C130 candidates
p0_a.probability_solver: 32 fixed Frank-Wolfe iterations from uniform on the K=5 simplex
p0_a.decision_index: argmin of predicted normalized ADE plus predicted normalized FDE, independent of probability argmax
p0_a.failure_rule: If any gate fails, close C134 without P0-B or training. Do not repair with temperatures, gates, residuals, weights, epochs, seeds, or target access.

p0_b.authorization: Run only if every P0-A gate passes.
p0_b.name: continuous_physical_action_headroom_and_solver_audit
p0_b.diagnostic_target_use: Target is permitted only to measure oracle continuous-action headroom, never as an inference solver input.
p0_b.failure_rule: If P0-B fails, close C134 before model training without changing thresholds or solver budget.

p1.authorization: Implement and train only after P0-A and P0-B pass.
p1.execution_order: Fold 0 first; folds 1 and 2 concurrently only after fold 0 passes every gate.
p1.ablation: One matched direct-decoder ablation is authorized only after the primary model passes replication.

claim_boundary: C134 is train-only blocked algorithm screening. P0-A is a fold-0 availability gate because formal C130 exists only for fold 0. No development, sealed-test, or confirmatory generalization claim is authorized.
